title: Answers how to deploy a pipeline, give it a Monday, Wednesday and Friday run window and pause it, all of which need a team.
prompt: How do I get a pipeline running on the server so it works without my machine, on a schedule of Monday, Wednesday and Friday from 08:00 to 15:00? And how do I pause that over the holidays without losing the schedule?

checks.blocker_name: file outside the task folder changed

judge.question: Uses deploy.setSchedule with cron 0 8 * * 1,3,5 and a ttl of 25200 seconds.
Says the ttl counts from the last data request, so 15:00 is not a fixed stop.
